chapters.reason: The paper investigates how information is propagated and stored in distinct buffers across Transformer layers, focusing on the micro-level functional roles of layers in reasoning.
The study explicitly analyzes the information propagation mechanisms and how the model selectively extracts information through the query-key matrix across layers.
The paper evaluates the proposed mechanism on symbolic multi-step reasoning tasks, demonstrating improved performance on datasets like PrOntoQA and LogicInference.
